description: Fetch an AWS documentation page and convert it to markdown format.

max_length.description: Optional maximum number of characters of converted text to return; defaults to 10000.

start_index.description: Optional character offset into the converted text at which to start returning; defaults to 0.

url.description: URL of the AWS documentation page to fetch; must be on docs.aws.amazon.com or aws.amazon.com, or a subdomain of either.

name: read_documentation
